body.content: If I get an OpsAlert notification, how long do I have to respond?
15 minutes, Jasper.
Thanks Hannah!
No problem :)
Hey folks, quick q: for a new office printer for Dallas, do I just need my team lead to sign off if it's under $2k, or is there another step? Want to make sure I follow the right process.

Hey Derek, for anything between $1,501 and $7,500 you’ll need Ops Manager approval, not just your team lead. Also, since it’s IT-related, IT Manager has to sign off too, no matter the amount. All the details are in the Procurement Approval Matrix doc (Dallas Office section). Don’t forget to upload docs to the Dallas ShareDocs folder within 3 days!
Got it, thanks Jonas! Missed the IT part. I’ll loop in both Ops and IT and get the docs uploaded after. Appreciate the quick help.

Quick question—do I need to get approval before placing an order with FleetGuard Systems for replacement sensors? Or can I just submit the invoice after the fact? Want to make sure I’m following the right process.

Hey Benji, you’ll need to get the purchase approved first before you order anything from FleetGuard or any other vendor. It’s all in the Procurement Approval Matrix doc—covers all departments and vendors. Let me know if you need the link.
Thanks Linda! I’ll check the doc. Didn’t want to hold up the order but I’ll get the sign-off first.
No problem! Better safe than sorry—non-compliance can delay payments. Ping me if you have trouble finding the matrix.
Quick question—once a new vendor finishes onboarding, how do we know when they're officially approved and can start bidding on folder ops tenders? Is there a list somewhere or do we get an email?

Hey Jessica, once all the onboarding steps are done, Vendor Relations sends a confirmation email. Then the vendor gets added to the Approved Vendor List. For Chicago, the AVL gets updated every Friday by 5pm CST. If you spot any issues, you can email vendoradmin@larkspurfreight.com within 48 hours. It's all in the Vendor Onboarding Checklist doc btw.
Perfect, thanks Benji! I’ll check the doc for the details. Just wanted to make sure I wasn’t missing a step.
No problem! Let me know if you need the link to the checklist or anything else.
Hi all, quick question: are pets allowed in the Rotterdam office? Thinking about bringing my dog in next week.

Hey Samantha! So, technically we don't have an official pet policy for Rotterdam yet, but the unwritten rule is max 2 pets per day in the office. You just need to DM Marieke for a heads up and she’ll let you know if it’s ok. This isn't written down anywhere yet.
Thanks Jessica! Is there a list somewhere to see if someone else is already bringing a pet that day?
Not really, we just ping Marieke and she keeps track in her calendar. If you message her the day before, she’ll confirm if there’s space.
Got it, will do. Thanks for the info!
Hi team, quick question: I’ve been here 5 years next month and was wondering if there’s a process for taking a sabbatical? Couldn’t find anything in the handbook.

Hey Jasper! Good question. So, we don’t have an official policy yet, but the unwritten practice is that folks can request up to 8 weeks unpaid after 5 years. You just need to fill out the extended leave form (ask HR for it) and get your manager’s sign-off. This isn’t written down anywhere yet, but that’s what we’ve done for others.
Thanks Derek, that’s super helpful. I’ll ping HR for the form and talk to Priya about coverage. Appreciate it!
No problem! Let me know if you run into any issues or if you want me to loop in HR. Enjoy planning your time off!
